verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.perplexity.ai (HTTP 200) and per-page Markdown versions of the docs. Those Markdown pages explicitly point agents to the llms.txt documentation index, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is also served; many cited doc pages are reachable as .md URLs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle.
